cmsy_sources(): CMSY++及其所需软件的来源

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_sources.Rmd
cmsy_sources.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_sources()

说明

本函数列出本包CMSY++相关函数用到的每个组件，包括其版本、下载链接、文件大小、校验值（MD5和SHA-256）、许可证和应引用的文献：CMSY++代码、人工神经网络、用户手册和训练数据（随本包提供）、各操作系统的JAGS安装程序、rjags包、CMSY++用到的其他R包，以及内置先验表所依据的FishBase和SeaLifeBase版本（见cmsy_priors()）。

English

This function lists every component used by the CMSY++ functions of the package, with its version, download link, file size, checksums (MD5 and SHA-256), licence and the reference to cite: the CMSY++ code, neural network, user guide and training data (bundled with the package), the JAGS installers for each operating system, the rjags package, the other R packages CMSY++ uses, and the FishBase and SeaLifeBase releases behind the built-in table of priors (see cmsy_priors()).

用法 

cmsy_sources(component = NULL)

参数

component
可选文本，只保留与之匹配的组件，例如”JAGS”或”CMSY”。
English Optional text to keep only matching components, e.g. “JAGS” or “CMSY”.

返回值

一个数据框，每个文件或包一行。

English

A data frame with one row per file or package.

详细说明

随本包提供的CMSY++文件是GEOMAR的存储库OceanRep（记录52147）中未经修改的2021年3月版本，以CC BY 4.0许可证发布；同样的代码也发布在GitHub：https://github.com/SISTA16/cmsyPlusPlus。cmsy_run()在运行前会对代码副本做少量有记录的修改（见cmsy_system()），不改变方法本身。本包与CMSY++的作者无关联，也未得到其认可。

English

The CMSY++ files bundled with the package are the unmodified March 2021 release from GEOMAR’s repository OceanRep (record 52147), published under the CC BY 4.0 licence; the same code is on GitHub at https://github.com/SISTA16/cmsyPlusPlus. cmsy_run() applies a few documented changes to a copy of the code before running it (see cmsy_system()); they do not change the method. faofishingreport is not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors of CMSY++.

参考文献

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., Palomares, M.L.D., Tsikliras, A.C., Dimarchopoulou, D., Touloumis, K., Demirel, N., Vianna, G.M.S., Scarcella, G., Schijns, R., Liang, C. and Pauly, D. (2023). New developments in the analysis of catch time series as the basis for fish stock assessments: the CMSY++ method. Acta Ichthyologica et Piscatoria 53: 173-189. doi:10.3897/aiep.53.105910

Froese, R., Demirel, N., Coro, G. and Winker, H. (2021). User Guide for CMSY++. GEOMAR, Germany, 17 pp. https://oceanrep.geomar.de/id/eprint/52147/

Plummer, M. (2003). JAGS: A program for analysis of Bayesian graphical models using Gibbs sampling. Proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Distributed Statistical Computing (DSC 2003), Vienna. https://mcmc-jags.sourceforge.io/

示例 

# Every component, with version, file, licence and link
src <- cmsy_sources()
src[, c("component", "version", "platform", "file", "license")]

# The JAGS installers for each system, with their checksums
cmsy_sources("JAGS")[, c("component", "version", "platform", "url", "sha256")]

# The references to cite
unique(src$citation[nzchar(src$citation)])
